Card Q&A.q: Can I process the part of the effect after "then" in this card's [Your Turn] effect without meeting the "by" condition?

Effect: [Start of Your Turn] If you have 2 or less memory, set it to 3.

[Your Turn] When any of your play cost 7 or higher [Cyborg], [Machine] or [DM] trait Digimon are played, by suspending this Tamer, ＜Draw 1＞ and gain 1 memory. Then, you may place 1 card from your hand face down as any of those Digimon's bottom digivolution card.
Security Effect: [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
